title: Class size, 2026-27
source: NYC Department of Education: Class Size Report (City Council), November 2026-27, School Data; and Table C of the Nov. 15, 2026 Annual Report on Implementation of New York State's Class Size Caps (Education Law 211-d)
vintage: 2026-27 November report and Nov. 15, 2026 state report (both data as of 10/31/26)

avg_class_size_overall.label: Average class size
avg_class_size_overall.definition: Average number of students per class across the school's general education, ICT, G&T and accelerated classes, as of 10/31/26: K-5 official classes, K-5 cluster classes (gym, art, music, science and other subjects taught by a cluster teacher, counted by DOE starting in 2026-27) and every 6-12 course section in all subjects. Self-contained special classes are left out, as in DOE's own averages. Computed by this script as total students / total classes over those rows; the same formula on the whole file reproduces DOE's citywide 21.4.
avg_class_size_overall.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheets 'K-5 Average' (Program Type Gen Ed, ICT, G&T, ICT & G&T, K-5 Cluster) and 'MS HS Average' (Program Type not 'SC')

avg_class_size_k5.label: Avg. class size, K-5 official classes
avg_class_size_k5.definition: Average students per K-5 official class (the homeroom class where students get core instruction: general ed, ICT, G&T, and ICT & G&T), as of 10/31/26, from ATS. Cluster classes and self-contained classes are left out. Includes bridge classes and a handful of grade 6 official classes that DOE puts on the K-5 sheet. Computed as total students / total classes.
avg_class_size_k5.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheet 'K-5 Average', 'Subject' = 'Official Class', 'Program Type' in {Gen Ed, ICT, G&T, ICT & G&T}

avg_class_size_k5_cluster.label: Avg. K-5 cluster class
avg_class_size_k5_cluster.definition: Average students per K-5 cluster class (a subject such as physical education, art, music, science or technology taught by a teacher who teaches it across several official classes), as of 10/31/26, from STARS. New in DOE's 2026-27 reports. Cluster classes for self-contained students are left out.
avg_class_size_k5_cluster.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheet 'K-5 Average', 'Program Type' = 'K-5 Cluster'

avg_class_size_mshs.label: Avg. class size, 6-12 core subjects
avg_class_size_mshs.definition: Average students per class in grades 6-12 English, math, science and social studies course sections (general ed, ICT, accelerated, ICT & accelerated), fall 2026 term as of 10/31/26. DOE defines a class as students 'meeting at the same time ... in the same place.' Self-contained excluded. Computed as total students / total classes over those departments.
avg_class_size_mshs.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheet 'MS HS Average', 'Department' in {English, Math, Science, Social Studies}, 'Program Type' != 'SC'

avg_class_size_gened.label: Avg. general ed class
avg_class_size_gened.definition: Average students per general education class (program type 'Gen Ed'), K-5 official classes plus all 6-12 course sections, all subjects, as of 10/31/26. K-5 cluster classes have no program type and are left out. Computed as total students / total classes.
avg_class_size_gened.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheets 'K-5 Average' and 'MS HS Average', 'Program Type' = 'Gen Ed'

avg_class_size_ict.label: Avg. ICT class
avg_class_size_ict.definition: Average students per Integrated Co-Teaching class (a general and a special education teacher together), K-5 official classes plus all 6-12 course sections, as of 10/31/26. Following DOE, combined ICT & G&T and ICT & accelerated classes count as ICT. Computed as total students / total classes.
avg_class_size_ict.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheets 'K-5 Average' ('Program Type' in {ICT, ICT & G&T}) and 'MS HS Average' ('Program Type' in {ICT, ICT & Acc})

avg_class_size_special.label: Avg. self-contained special class
avg_class_size_special.definition: Average students per self-contained special education class (K-5/K-8 official classes in settings 12:1:1, 12:1, 8:1:1, 6:1:1, 15:1, 12:1:4, plus 6-12 'SC' course sections), as of 10/31/26. K-5 cluster classes for self-contained students are left out, as in DOE's summary. These sizes are set by students' IEP settings and are not covered by the state caps. Null means the school reported no self-contained classes. Computed as total students / total classes.
avg_class_size_special.source_field: sum('Number of Students') / sum('Number of Classes'), sheets 'K-5 Average' ('Program Type' starting 'SC ') and 'MS HS Average' ('Program Type' = 'SC')

n_classes.label: Classes counted
n_classes.definition: Number of classes in the November report for this school, all program types: K-5 official and cluster classes plus 6-12 course sections in every subject (a high school class is one section of one course, so this is far larger than the number of homerooms).
n_classes.source_field: sum('Number of Classes'), sheets 'K-5 Average' and 'MS HS Average', all rows

pupil_teacher_ratio.label: Pupil-teacher ratio
pupil_teacher_ratio.definition: DOE's school pupil-teacher ratio (students per teacher) for 2026-27 from Table C, rounded to one decimal. Neither file says which staff count as teachers. It is not a class-size measure.
pupil_teacher_ratio.source_field: 'School Pupil-Teacher Ratio', Table C sheet '26-27 Pupil-to-Teacher Ratio'

cap_pct_at_or_below.label: Classes within state cap
cap_pct_at_or_below.definition: Share of the school's classes at or below the state class-size caps (K-3: 20, grades 4-8: 23, grades 9-12: 25, physical education and performing groups: 40), as of 10/31/26. DOE granted no exemptions for 2026-27, so every counted class is in the share. Counts K-5 official and cluster classes and 6-12 course sections, including exam prep courses; excludes self-contained classes, 3-K and pre-K, District 75/79/88 schools and charters. Computed by summing Table C's K-5 rows and 6-12 course rows for the school; the same sum citywide gives DOE's 73.4%.
cap_pct_at_or_below.source_field: sum('Total # of classes at or below cap') / sum('Total # of classes'), Table C sheets '26-27 K-5 by DBN & Grade' and '26-27 6-12 by DBN & Course'

cap_n_classes.label: Classes subject to cap
cap_n_classes.definition: Number of classes counted for the state cap, as of 10/31/26 (the denominator of cap_pct_at_or_below).
cap_n_classes.source_field: sum('Total # of classes'), Table C 2026-27 sheets

cap_n_over.label: Classes over cap
cap_n_over.definition: Number of classes above the state cap, as of 10/31/26.
cap_n_over.source_field: sum('Total # of classes over cap'), Table C 2026-27 sheets

notes: One vintage. The average-size fields come from DOE's November 2026-27 City Council report and the cap_* fields from Table C of the Nov. 15, 2026 state-law report; both count classes as of 10/31/26.

New in 2026-27, DOE counts K-5 cluster classes (subjects such as physical education, art, music, science and technology taught by a teacher who teaches that subject across several official classes) and 6-12 exam prep courses, both in the averages and in the cap counts. DOE's citywide 'all schools' average (21.4) includes K-5 cluster classes, and so does avg_class_size_overall. Because of these additions, 2026-27 figures don't compare directly with earlier years; avg_class_size_k5 (official classes only) is the closest to earlier K-5 figures.

Averages are computed by this script as total students / total classes over the rows named in each field's source_field. That is DOE's own row formula, and run on the whole file it reproduces every citywide figure in DOE's November 2026-27 summary (all schools 21.4; K-5 Gen Ed 19.1, ICT 19.5, G&T 23.9, cluster 19.0; MS Gen Ed 22.2, ICT 23.3, accelerated 25.3; HS Gen Ed 22.9, ICT 24.1). The build stops if any check fails.

Self-contained classes are kept out of avg_class_size_overall, _k5 and _mshs, as in DOE's averages, because their size is set by IEP ratios (12:1:1 and so on). They are reported on their own in avg_class_size_special. n_classes counts every program type.
G&T and accelerated classes count toward avg_class_size_overall, _k5 and _mshs but have no field of their own. Following DOE, combined ICT & G&T and ICT & accelerated classes count as ICT.
DOE drops outliers: general education and ICT classes with more than 100 or fewer than 5 students, and self-contained classes with fewer than 2.

Suppression: none in the columns used. 'Number of Students', 'Number of Classes' and 'Average Class Size' are fully populated. Only 'Minimum Class Size' and 'Maximum Class Size' (and the 'Class Size' column on the Counts sheets) mask small values as '<15'; none of those are used.

A null average means the school had no classes in that category (for example avg_class_size_mshs for an elementary school, or avg_class_size_special at a school with no self-contained classes). Nothing was suppressed.

cap_pct_at_or_below sums Table C's K-5 grade-and-subject rows and 6-12 course rows. Citywide that gives 168,337 of 229,491 classes = 73.4%, matching DOE's reported 73.4%. DOE's report: 'NYCPS did not utilize exemptions in this reporting period to meet the annual milestone.' So, unlike 2025-26, no class drops out of the share. 1,531 schools have a share.
Caps: K-3 20, grades 4-8 23, grades 9-12 25, physical education and performing-group classes 40. The law required 70% of classes at or below the caps in 2026-27; DOE says it reached 73.4%.

Coverage: community school districts 1-32 only. Neither file includes District 75 (citywide special education), District 79 (alternative) or District 88 schools, or charter schools, so those schools get no record here.
pupil_teacher_ratio comes from Table C's 2026-27 sheet; the November school file has no ratio sheet.
Table C also has 2025-26 sheets (with exemptions) and 2027-28 projections; neither is used.
